title: Parity Game
statementMd:
You are fishing with polar bears Alice and Bob. While waiting for the fish to bite, the polar bears get bored. They come up with a game. First Alice and Bob each writes a 01-string (strings that only contain character "`0`" and "`1`") $*a*$ and $*b*$. Then you try to turn $*a*$ into $*b*$ using two types of operations:

- Write $*parity*(*a*)$ to the end of $*a*$. For example, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2489b4bd10b8f67bed8ee4614ff21d963da20895.png).
- Remove the first character of $*a*$. For example, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/073a30771e84caf65e9a79493bf290f14d315cbe.png). You cannot perform this operation if $*a*$ is empty.

You can use as many operations as you want. The problem is, is it possible to turn $*a*$ into $*b*$?

The $*parity*$ of a 01-string is $1$ if there is an odd number of "`1`"s in the string, and $0$ otherwise.

## Input

The first line contains the string $*a*$ and the second line contains the string $*b*$ $(1 ≤ |*a*|, |*b*| ≤ 1000)$. Both strings contain only the characters "`0`" and "`1`". Here $|*x*|$ denotes the length of the string $*x*$.

## Output

Print "`YES`" (without quotes) if it is possible to turn $*a*$ into $*b*$, and "`NO`" (without quotes) otherwise.

## Note

In the first sample, the steps are as follows: $01011 → 1011 → 011 → 0110$
statementZhMd:
你正在和北极熊 Alice 与 Bob 一起钓鱼。在等待鱼儿上钩时，北极熊们感到很无聊。于是，他们想出了一个游戏。首先，Alice 和 Bob 各自写下一个 01 字符串（只包含字符 "`0`" 和 "`1`" 的字符串）$*a*$ 和 $*b*$。然后，你需要使用以下两种操作将 $*a*$ 变为 $*b*$：

- 将 $*a*$ 的 *parity*(*a*) 写到 $*a*$ 的末尾。例如，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2489b4bd10b8f67bed8ee4614ff21d963da20895.png)。
- 删除 $*a*$ 的第一个字符。例如，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/073a30771e84caf65e9a79493bf290f14d315cbe.png)。当 $*a*$ 为空时，不能执行此操作。

你可以执行任意多次操作。问题是，是否可能将 $*a*$ 变为 $*b*$？

一个 01 字符串的 *parity* 定义如下：如果字符串中有奇数个 "`1`"，则其值为 $1$；否则为 $0$。

## 输入格式

第一行包含字符串 $*a*$，第二行包含字符串 $*b*$ $(1 ≤ |*a*|, |*b*| ≤ 1000)$。两个字符串都只包含字符 "`0`" 和 "`1`"。其中，$|*x*|$ 表示字符串 $*x*$ 的长度。

## 输出格式

如果可以将 $*a*$ 变为 $*b*$，输出 "`YES`"（不含引号）；否则输出 "`NO`"（不含引号）。

## 说明

第一个样例中的操作步骤如下：$01011 → 1011 → 011 → 0110$
